limitations: One extracted primary macro; attachment transistor models include device junction geometry but lack new interconnect extraction, bond/package and shared returns.
Disabled controls are applied voltages, not a physical local supervisor. DC points do not preserve stored charge.

RF/clock attached cores are declared capacitance only; RF driver reverse junctions, input admittance and active signal quality remain unknown. Universal is fully populated only with currently implemented attachments.
No duplicate primary protection and no branch removed between states. Separate instances of a shared design remain required for simultaneous independent lanes.
AC admittance and DC backfeed screen cannot establish eye, noise, distortion, ESD or transient off-state safety.

decisions.universal: Do not select: current populated attachment candidate exceeds RF and wired loading allocations before new routes. This does not prove every co-designed universal circuit impossible.
decisions.wired_combined: Do not select simple union: RX bypass exceeds allocation.
decisions.wired_shared_termination: Keep as co-design experiment: reduced loading still exceeds RX allocation; termination behavior differs. Preserve separate selected attachments.
decisions.rf_rx_reference: Keep common lean structure and investigate populated bias/receiver attachment. Loading screen passes allocation, but real cores, bias noise and power-off bias-current handling remain unresolved.

current_spec_revalidation.scope: Implementation-spec edits change evidence/selection metadata only. Regenerating all eight comparison models produces identical bytes to the simulated models. Original simulation source hashes are preserved. No repeated simulation or canonical-layout requalification claimed.
